text: With `claude_disallowBackgroundBash: true`, a Bash call requesting `run_in_background: true` is denied by the synthesized `PreToolUse` hook and the command runs synchronously inside the turn — no `background_task_*` events are emitted and `result` carries no in-flight signal. **Conclusiveness precondition:** this is an absence-shaped criterion, so it is evidence only on a run where the model *actually attempted* `run_in_background: true`. A run in which the model chose to execute the command synchronously of its own accord satisfies every absence assertion vacuously — the absence is then the model's doing, not the lever's. A transcript showing no such attempt makes the run INCONCLUSIVE, not passing.
title: With claude_disallowBackgroundBash: true, a Bash call attempting run_in_background is denied and runs synchronously — conclusive only on a run where the model actually attempted it
